xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex22032024-10-1509-181" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n=" Colophon Part 2 (40b2-5) (p. 122:2-5)"/> ༄ || shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa'i | don la dmyigs shing 'khrul pa'i skyon rnams sel cing sku × 'khrungs pa'i | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">dam pa shes rab 'bar</rs> zhes grags | chu snod cig nas cig b+h+yo bzhin | don dang tshig rnams rdzogs par yang' | 'gro la phan phyir don rnams sgrogs <lb n="40b4"/> <choice><sic>gsregs</sic><corr>bsregs</corr></choice> don <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5878"><abbr>ye shes</abbr> rgyal</rs> zhes grags | <choice><sic>skyes</sic><corr>skye</corr></choice> shis 'jigs nas chos <choice><sic>rgyad</sic><corr>brgyad</corr></choice> bor || don tsam snang yang bye brag <choice><sic>rjed</sic><corr>brjed</corr></choice> | dran pa bso phyir <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4335">chos 'khor bsam yas</rs> dag du b(r)is | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6962">dge' bshes zhug ston</rs> zhes byar grags || 'gro ba 'dul kyin bzhan don mdzad | ° thos mang sems <note type="gloss">dang</note> sims <note type="editorial">sems?</note> kyi × me long lta || <lb n="40b5"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">shes rab thog po</rs> zhes su grags || × || × || × || × ItI || × ||</seg></TEI>
